_comment: Project-scoped MCP servers. With ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=true, tool schemas load on-demand. alwaysLoad: true forces eager load for every-turn tools. Pinned versions where possible — review before enabling community servers.
_examples_comment: To enable an example server: copy its block from _disabled_examples into mcpServers and configure env vars.

_disabled_examples._doc: Catalogue of optional servers. NOT parsed by Claude Code — kept at top level, outside mcpServers. Copy any entry into mcpServers to activate.

computer-use._doc: Only enable in a disposable sandbox/VM.

filesystem._doc: Always-loaded. Sandboxed filesystem access scoped to this project.

github._doc: Always-loaded. Official GitHub-maintained MCP. OAuth or PAT.

chrome-devtools._doc: Deferred via Tool Search. Browser debugging, perf, Lighthouse. Version pinned per Round 4 audit H-FO2 (no @latest in production — supply-chain risk).

playwright._doc: Deferred. E2E driving with deterministic refs. Version pinned.

context7._doc: Deferred. Up-to-date library docs by version. Token-heavy. Pinned per AC-29.

postgres._doc: Deferred. Read-only SQL by default; crystaldba fork (official postgres MCP deprecated).

sentry._doc: Deferred. Official Sentry remote MCP, OAuth.

apify._doc: Deferred. Official Apify MCP — 5000+ Actors including Crawlee-powered scrapers. OAuth via Apify.

semgrep._doc: Deferred. Run `semgrep mcp` from local install for SAST in-agent.

scheduled-tasks._doc: Built-in Anthropic scheduled-tasks MCP. Allows /loop and overnight task wiring. Version pinned per Round 4 audit H-FO2 (no @latest in production).

openfeature._doc: OpenFeature gateway — provider-agnostic flag MCP. Drives flag-rollout / flag-cleanup / experiment skills. Set OPENFEATURE_PROVIDER and provider-specific env in .claude/settings.local.json.

posthog._doc: PostHog — product analytics, feature flags, A/B experiments, session replays. Lower-friction flag store than LaunchDarkly for small teams.

graphify._doc: Graphify — code-as-knowledge-graph. Tree-sitter parsing across 32 languages; agents prefer `query_graph` / `shortest_path` / `get_neighbors` for cross-module questions over grep on >3 files. NOT a memory layer (we keep markdown ADRs/patterns/incidents). Pin to 0.8.21 — pre-1.0 churn risk. Round 5 A1.

langfuse._doc: Langfuse MCP — prompt management only (NOT tracing; tracing is native OTEL via env vars in settings.json). Agents can fetch versioned prompts from Langfuse via this MCP. Round 6 A. Pinned per Round 4 audit H-FO2.

fireflies._doc: Fireflies sales-call transcripts — read-only for feedback-extractor agent (Round 7 C). Auth via FIREFLIES_API_KEY in env. Deferred.

intercom._doc: Intercom support tickets + conversations — read-only for feedback-extractor agent (Round 7 C). Deferred.

pendo._doc: Pendo in-product feedback + polls — read-only for feedback-extractor (Round 7 C). Deferred.

replicate._doc: Replicate — FLUX Schnell (Apache-2.0, $0.003/img) + FLUX Pro (commercial, $0.04). Used by image-generation skill (Round 9 D). Deferred.

recraft._doc: Recraft V3 — raster + native SVG vector generation. $0.04 raster / $0.08 SVG. Used for brand icons, scalable assets. Round 9 D. Deferred.

pexels._doc: Pexels stock photo — CC0, no attribution required. Fallback when AI photo fails. Round 9 D. Deferred.

osv._doc: OSV vulnerability database MCP (StacklokLabs). First-class query_vulns(package, version, ecosystem) tool for agents — alternative to raw curl. Round 8 A. Pinned per §X security rule.
